instruction: Create a text file named 'photo_list.txt' on the Desktop that lists all image filenames in my Pictures directory, one per line.

metadata.explanation: Task requires listing all 3 image filenames (picture1.jpg, picture2.jpg, picture3.jpg) in a text file on Desktop, one per line. Evaluator reads the file and verifies all 3 expected filenames are present.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirements
Getter extracts the correct file content from /home/user/Desktop/photo_list.txt
Metric function properly handles expected parameter (type=rule) by directly accessing expected.get('required_files') and expected.get('exact_count')
Complete coverage: verifies both that all 3 required filenames are present AND that exactly 3 lines exist (no extra files)
Expected values are semantically correct - they match the 3 image files downloaded in the config setup
Metric logic is robust: splits by lines, strips whitespace, filters empty lines, checks presence of all required files
Order-independent checking is appropriate since instruction doesn't specify ordering requirement
Edge case handling: returns 0.0 for None or non-string results
